hypothesis.statement: StartGemFX's remaining 30 real closes by swapping the declaration order of `s32 idx = -1;` and `EffectHeader* h;` inside the shared inline helper StartFXSubGutsP (src/game/sfx/sfx.c:708) so that h is declared and assigned first. DEFINITION SITES, quoted from the live aligned view at commit b9453e2b0 (each register has exactly one definition in the first dispatch arm): the header pointer is defined in TARGET at `@0x2c addi r29,r30,948` and in OURS at `@0x30 addi r31,r30,948`; the -1 return value is defined in TARGET at `@0x34 li r31,-1` and in OURS at `@0x34 li r29,-1`. So the two webs are exchanged between r29 and r31, and the target gives the LOWER number to the header pointer -- the declaration-order signature -- while the addi/lwz emission order follows the assignment order.
